tasks.title: IRS withholding outcome check
tasks.confirmed_task: Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator for tax year 2026. Model a single filer who will be under 65 on 2027-01-01, is not blind, cannot be claimed as another person's dependent, and has no dependants. Use one job held for all of 2026, paid semi-monthly, with most recent pay 2026-07-15, $3,750 wages and $420 federal withholding on that pay, $48,750 year-to-date wages, and $5,460 year-to-date withholding. There are no bonuses, other income, adjustments, itemized or additional deductions, or credits; use the standard deduction. Return the projected refund or amount owed if withholding is unchanged and the estimator's recommended additional withholding per pay period for a zero-dollar target. Do not download or submit a W-4.

tasks.title: IRS two-job withholding reconciliation
tasks.confirmed_task: Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator for tax year 2026. Model a married couple filing jointly who will live together all year. Both spouses will be under 65 on 2027-01-01, neither is blind or claimable as another person's dependent, and they have two qualifying children under 17. Use two jobs held for all of 2026. Job A is biweekly with most recent pay 2026-07-17, $4,600 wages and $510 federal withholding on that pay, $64,400 year-to-date wages, and $7,140 year-to-date withholding. Job B is monthly with most recent pay 2026-06-30, $3,200 wages and $190 federal withholding on that pay, $19,200 year-to-date wages, and $1,140 year-to-date withholding. There are no bonuses, other income, adjustments, itemized or additional deductions, or credits other than the two qualifying children; use the standard deduction. Return the projected refund or amount owed if withholding is unchanged and the exact W-4 Step 3 and Step 4(c) entries the estimator recommends for each job for a zero-dollar target. Do not download or submit a W-4.
